boosts.virustotal-vs-local-mac-scout:
Order of operations after a link scare

  1. URL scan (VirusTotal or similar) if you only have the link · reputation is not Mac state.
  2. Local scout on your Macintosh · login items, profiles, recent installs · read-only.
  3. Battle Scout · paste innsegall-battle-scout-ai/v1 to any AI · honor triage_level.

What VirusTotal cannot see

  • Login items and launch agents on your Mac.
  • Configuration profiles or stale helper apps.
  • Whether you pasted into Terminal after a fake CAPTCHA page.

boosts.stale-launch-items-macintosh:
What to do if scouts flag stale items

  1. Open System Settings → General → Login Items · remove unknown helpers.
  2. Compare vendor name to the app you thought you installed · recruiter DM installs are a red flag.
  3. Re-run Voyage on the 1st or 15th · or send the scout after a scare.
